description: Hard enforcement rules for EaseStart agents. Unlike anti-patterns (advisory), guardrails are MANDATORY blocks and warnings that agents must enforce before recommending actions.
source: Inspired by Agentic OS Policy-as-Code Engine. Adapted for EaseStart's stage-gated methodology.

rules.message: ❌ Growth recommendations blocked until Stage 2 (idea validated). Complete exit criteria for current stage first.
rules.rationale: Growth before validation wastes resources on unproven products

rules.message: ❌ Paid advertising blocked until Stage 5. Organic channels must work first — ads amplify, they don't create demand.
rules.rationale: Paid ads before organic conversion is proven burns cash on broken funnels

rules.message: ❌ VC fundraising blocked until Stage 4 (PMF confirmed). Investors fund traction, not ideas.
rules.rationale: Raising without traction leads to bad terms and misaligned incentives

rules.message: ❌ Full-time hiring blocked until Stage 5. Automate with code first (Giantiny ③). Consider contractors for Stage 3-4.
rules.rationale: Premature hiring burns runway and creates management overhead before PMF

rules.message: ⚠️ Monthly cost >$500 — verify this aligns with current runway. Run unit economics check first.
rules.rationale: Solo founders should keep burn ultra-low until profitable

rules.message: ❌ Scaling blocked — Sean Ellis score below 40%. Fix product-market fit before investing in growth.
rules.rationale: Scaling without PMF is the most expensive startup mistake

rules.message: ⚠️ IRREVERSIBLE ACTION — This cannot be undone. Verify with CEO before proceeding. Show Impact Preview.
rules.rationale: Irreversible decisions require extra scrutiny — cannot Ctrl+Z in business

rules.message: ❌ Channel concentration rule: max 3 active channels before Stage 5. Double down on #1 channel instead.
rules.rationale: Spreading across 5+ channels means mediocre execution on all

rules.message: ⚠️ Platform concentration risk: >70% traffic from single channel. Diversify before it becomes existential.
rules.rationale: One algorithm change can kill 95% of traffic overnight

rules.message: ❌ Equity without vesting BLOCKED. 4-year vesting with 1-year cliff is mandatory. No exceptions.
rules.rationale: No-vesting equity is the #1 co-founder mistake — leads to dead equity

rules.message: ⚠️ Validation incomplete: fewer than 10 interviews. Patterns emerge at interview 7-8. Keep going.
rules.rationale: Sub-10 interview sample is statistically meaningless for pattern detection

rules.message: ❌ Public launch blocked until Stage 3 (MVP built + analytics tracking). Launching too early burns first impression.
rules.rationale: First impressions are irreversible — Product Hunt launches cannot be redone

rules.message: ⚠️ RUNWAY WARNING: less than 6 months remaining. Switch to revenue-generating activities only.
rules.rationale: Below 6 months runway triggers panic decisions — cut costs immediately

rules.message: ❌ EMERGENCY: less than 3 months runway. Only revenue-generating work allowed. All experiments halted.
rules.rationale: Below 3 months is existential — every action must generate revenue

rules.message: ⚠️ This recommendation may be outdated — the underlying rule has expired. Re-evaluate with current data.
rules.rationale: Market conditions change — strategies that worked 3 months ago may no longer apply

rules.message: ❌ LEVERAGE TEST FAILED — This initiative requires manual labor (Labor leverage). Giantiny ③ mandates: solve with Code or Media first. If it can't be automated, reject or redesign.
rules.rationale: Central Giantiny filter: every initiative must use Code or Media leverage. Adding manual labor breaks the 'thin shell' model and creates scaling dependencies on headcount.
rules.source: Giantiny Biz — Doc 8: Hard Gates & Guardrails (Phép thử Đòn bẩy)

rules.message: ⚠️ CONSULTATION RULE — High-impact recommendation without cross-domain validation. Giantiny Tealamoeba protocol requires consultation from at least 2 other domain agents before activation.
rules.rationale: Prevents tunnel vision. The Tealamoeba model requires every Amoeba to seek advice from 2 peers before activating a plan. Plans without sufficient consultation are suspended for CEO review.
rules.source: Giantiny Biz — Doc 4: Organization Structure (Tham vấn mục tiêu)

rules.message: ❌ AUTHENTICITY GATE — Content or positioning does not align with founder's specific knowledge and authentic voice. Identity Guard blocks generic or competitor-copying strategies.
rules.rationale: Founder's authentic brand is an unreplicable MOAT. Competitors can copy features in 3 months but cannot copy the trust an audience has in a specific person's name and philosophy.
rules.source: Giantiny Biz — Doc 8: Hard Gates & Guardrails (Authenticity Gate)

rules.message: ❌ BRAND SAFETY: Content flagged as Level 3 (Red). Blocked from publishing. Check lighthouse.yaml negative_constraints for violations.
rules.rationale: LOTUS Controller Micro level: Brand safety filter prevents content that touches banned topics, uses banned phrases, or risks audience trust.

rules.message: ⚠️ BRAND SAFETY: Content flagged as Level 2 (Yellow). Requires human review before publishing. Check against lighthouse.yaml negative_constraints.
rules.rationale: LOTUS Controller Micro level: Gray-area content needs founder review to ensure it aligns with brand voice and values.

rules.message: ⚠️ LOTUS ION MISSING — Content published without Ion Bank reference. All content should trace back to a strategic Ion for performance tracking.
rules.rationale: LOTUS Atomic Content System requires every piece of content to derive from an Ion. Untracked content cannot be analyzed for Diamond/Dead status.

rules.message: ⚠️ LOTUS LAYER VIOLATION — Synergy (S) content detected in Heartbeat mode. Synergy content should only appear during Spike campaigns (days 12-14). Check nutrition-matrix.yaml.
rules.rationale: LOTUS Nutrition Matrix rule: Selling in Heartbeat mode erodes trust. CTA/conversion content is reserved for Spike campaign cycles only.
